_meta.purpose: Fund-lifecycle events on a timeline, anchored to the district ledger, grouped into story chains. The atomic unit of the news/timeline layer. See news-timeline-schema.md.
_meta.rules: Same sourcing discipline as the ledger: every event carries a source + tier and a confidence (documented = gov source / reported = news only / alleged). amount_cr stays null unless PDF-cited (figure_gap). No event is fabricated; seeds are real, ledger-anchored stories.
_meta.coverage: 2 seed story chains (Birbhum MGNREGS freeze; Kolkata KMC grant dependency). Built to be extended by ingest_news.py + human anchoring.
_meta.scheme_ref_note: scheme_ref resolves against district-ledger.json _meta.scheme_registry / scheme_aliases. official_ref resolves against the district roster role keys + _meta.authority_map.

story_chains.title: Birbhum's MGNREGS money: frozen at the top for four years
story_chains.one_line: Centre froze WB's MGNREGS funds under Sec 27 (Mar 2022); ₹3,038 cr dues piled up; resumed Jun 2026 after Supreme Court intervention. Dysfunction = money WITHHELD upstream, not misspent.

story_chains.title: Kolkata's civic money: over half flows down as grant
story_chains.one_line: KMC's BE 2025-26 shows ₹2,897 cr of ₹5,525 cr receipts are Central+State grant — 52% grant-dependent, budget in deficit.

fiscal_events.title: Centre freezes MGNREGS fund release to West Bengal (Sec 27)
fiscal_events.summary: The Union stopped MGNREGS fund release to West Bengal from 9 March 2022 under Section 27 of the MGNREGA Act, citing non-compliance/corruption. Every MGNREGS-dependent district, including Birbhum, was cut off from wages at source.

primary_source.title: MGNREGS in West Bengal — why it was halted

fiscal_events.title: Pending MGNREGS dues to WB reach ₹3,038 cr (highest of any state)
fiscal_events.summary: Per the Centre's figure in the Rajya Sabha (2025), pending MGNREGS dues to West Bengal stood at ₹3,038 cr — the highest of any state. The state claims ₹18,000 cr across MGNREGS + PMAY-G. Rural districts like Birbhum bore the brunt: assets unbuilt, migration.

primary_source.title: Centre owes ₹3,000 crore MGNREGA dues to Bengal (Rajya Sabha)

fiscal_events.amount_note: ₹3,038 cr is a Centre-stated Rajya Sabha figure (news-reported); upgrade to the Lok Sabha/RS Q&A PDF for tier-1.

fiscal_events.title: Supreme Court intervention pushes MGNREGS restart
fiscal_events.summary: After roughly four years of frozen funds, Supreme Court intervention paved the way for MGNREGS to restart in West Bengal.

primary_source.title: MGNREGS in West Bengal — how it could restart

fiscal_events.title: MGNREGS work resumes in West Bengal
fiscal_events.summary: MGNREGS work resumed in West Bengal on 1 June 2026 after the near-four-year freeze, restoring the rural job-guarantee channel to districts like Birbhum.

fiscal_events.title: KMC budget: ₹2,897 cr of ₹5,525 cr receipts are Central+State grant
fiscal_events.summary: Kolkata Municipal Corporation's Budget Estimate 2025-26 records a 'Government Grant' (Central + State Grant-in-Aid) of ₹2,897 cr against total receipts of ₹5,524.84 cr — about 52% of the city's civic money flows down as grant, not raised locally. The budget is in deficit.
